name: Pullback to the 20-day in a strong uptrend
author: claude
hypothesis: In stocks whose 50-day is well above the 200-day, a dip below the 20-day average that turns up (an up close) resumes the trend.
filter: ma50_over_ma200 > {trend} and dist_ma20 < -{dip} and dist_ma50 > 0 and ret_1 > 0 and not avoid
